interpretation_boundary: The experiment identifies the paired effect of an injected affine encoder mismatch on the selected artifacts and data.
It does not prove that a deployed harness is currently mismatched or estimate the prevalence of such mismatches.
Dataset scope and sampling are recorded explicitly; subset results must not be presented as full-dataset accuracy.
Internal endpoint occupancy is not an exact clamp-event counter because natural or rounded endpoint values are observationally indistinguishable from clipped values.
